card.name: Linking words before severe outcomes
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "including", "up to", "and", "even" or a comma, placed right after a named adverse condition. The next words name a more severe outcome, such as fatalities, rhabdomyolysis, paralysis or liver necrosis.

modes.label: including after a condition
modes.description: The word "including" follows an adverse event and leads into a worse outcome.
modes.example: Postmarketing cases of respiratory depression,<< including>> fatalities have been reported with use of prom

modes.label: up to / even / and
modes.description: A short linking word escalates from a mild to a severe effect.
modes.example: hypotension muscle weakness up<< to>> and including muscular and respiratory paralysis, p

modes.label: comma in a list of conditions
modes.description: A comma follows a condition and introduces a more serious one in a warning list.
modes.example: Renal dysfunction<<,>> acute renal failure, osmotic neph

card.writes: No clear effect on the output; the promoted tokens are mixed and mostly Chinese connectives.
card.plain: It fires on the small word that leads from one side effect into a more serious one, such as "including fatalities".
